notes.title: The 2nd continent in the 8th double-speed-world is opened for registration. 1.4.41 Inside
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28454336/cb58f10e8baad2707f5a3e3517fbee2b0d254479.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28454336/75108d58ab6f8766acac59d78d2f575288e1d236.gif[/img]
Kazakhstania is already [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28454336/6ef76a51307bd0f60cd7a7d22aa58cdda8555d17.png[/img] waiting for you..............More info [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28454336/5286f4a9f6e3c822d3ddd29866f781793b8d4668.png[/img]

[b]And in the meantime a curious update 1.4.41 has been released.[/b]
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28454336/2565eb2ee57a8ca1324f78a90c0d8ec57da2cf90.png[/img]

Gloomy [b]Morgenstern[/b] and Bloody [b]Robodog[/b] are available to be trained in cities
They are [b]truly[/b] dangerous in a battle...


There is a description of a fresh new world below, that has just been opened. 

But at first a few bright combat screenshots.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28454336/6af01f3b1f9ef4f7715274a28000c9bcbb94d132.png[/img]

They for sure do not reflect the full intensity of the game...
From the Stone Age to the present times!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28454336/a52c4be48587f78d587c1fab80432c9eb05412c0.png[/img]

Hundreds of buildings and unit types, 4 races, hours of battle in a real time!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28454336/e47f1dd5809b1eb0473301ab4c9d56c9911cb725.png[/img]

But, nevertheless, please the eye and hint that it will be extremely interesting ...


And now the promised description of the new 8th world ...

The first country which puts SS on course wins the world.

[list]
[*]The 1st continent Gondwana is opened for registration. All climate zones except snow are available.
[*]The 2nd continent will have only grasslands and snow;
[*]The 3rd: all climate zones (but very little of prairie);
[/list]

The parameters of the world are the following:
[list]
[*] production speed — [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28454336/6ef76a51307bd0f60cd7a7d22aa58cdda8555d17.png[/img]
[*] buildings maintenance — [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28454336/6ef76a51307bd0f60cd7a7d22aa58cdda8555d17.png[/img]
[*] constructing speed  — [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28454336/6ef76a51307bd0f60cd7a7d22aa58cdda8555d17.png[/img]
[*] troops speed — [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28454336/6ef76a51307bd0f60cd7a7d22aa58cdda8555d17.png[/img]
[*] troops costs — [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28454336/6ef76a51307bd0f60cd7a7d22aa58cdda8555d17.png[/img]
[*] troops maintenance — [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28454336/6ef76a51307bd0f60cd7a7d22aa58cdda8555d17.png[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28454336/6ef76a51307bd0f60cd7a7d22aa58cdda8555d17.png[/img]

[*] carrying capacity of troops — [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28454336/6ef76a51307bd0f60cd7a7d22aa58cdda8555d17.png[/img]

notes.title: Version 1.4.39 - changelist tweaked

tags.feature: A new mode in the combat simulator — [b]simulation of a battle by a city[/b] (with tactics and waves);
Amount of fortifications on the battlefield can now be taken into account in tactics rules;

tags.balance_change: Troops of different countries [b]can't join the same military operation[/b] anymore;
Troops which are known to less than 50% of country players have 15% [b]military bonus penalty[/b];
Peacekeepers and shy troops [b]do not affect the size of army[/b] in a battle queue;

tags.feature: Defensive military operation can now be [b]cancelled by owner of the targeted city[/b];
A city has to exist at least 12 hours or more, to be used by transport ships to debark troops;

tags.balance_change: Time to embark or disembark on a coast  reduced to 24 hours (48 hours before);
If a military operation has started, it can't be cancelled during a battle by the targeted city.

notes.title: Version 1.4.37 change log update
notes.content:
In addition to already announced changes:

[b]— Ships can now enter and exit a city by any direction, if diagonal directions are possible (ships could use only diagonal directions before);[/b]
Previous restriction is no longer relevant and even hinders, so we remove it. Exits to seas remain available. This only slightly reduces water paths.

[b]— A tool which shows best path between any land map spots has been implemented (for Premium account users only);[/b]
Players have been waiting for such in-game tool, and we have finally made it!

notes.title: Version 1.4.37 (not implemented)
notes.content:
Version 1.4.37 is being developed. Expected changes:

[b]— Chances to get a Great Citizen are tweaked;[/b]
Chances to get a GC are changed in order to make GCs appear more even.

[b]— The coefficients of scientific distribution are changed;[/b]
Changed in order to reduce the amount of scientific cities needed in countries.

[b]— Each city can have 2 Mints (1 before). The cost of a Mint reduced;[/b]

[b]— The Colosseum provides 8% bonus of war (9% before);[/b]
[b]— War Bonus of Luck provides 8% per level (9% before);[/b]
[b]— War Bonus of Great Generals is slightly reduced.[/b]
The last expected changes in order to reduce the war bonus.

[b]— Implementation of several measures to prevent unexpected influence on battles.[/b]
Details will be announced later.

Implementation date is yet unknown.

notes.title: The 6th International game world is coming! (UPDATED)
notes.content:
Estimated launch date - [b]1 September[/b].
Estimated launch time - [b]16:00[/b] (UTC)

For this world, winners are defined per ratings.

The speed of all processes is [b]doubled[/b]. The parameters to be changed for this world are the following:
[list]
[*] production speed - 2x
[*] buildings maintenance - 2x
[*] constructing speed - 2x
[*] troops speed - 2x
[*] troops costs - 2x
[*] troops maintenance - 4x
[*] efficiency of "Cutthroats" - 2x
[*] efficiency of "Demolishers" - 2x
[*] traps damage before a battle - 2x
[*] carrying capacity of troops - 2x
[*] population growth - 2x
[*] rate of consumption by population - 2x
[*] merchants speed - 2x
[*] chances to get a Great Citizen - 2x

The following parameters are [b]decreased twice[/b]:
[*] travel time of workers and settlers when sent on a mission
[*] amount of troops given as a reward for tasks
[*] amount of troops at barbarian cities that appear after certain tasks are fulfilled
[*] time of protection after registration

The launch date might be corrected. Stay tuned!
